name: Sigarda
aliases: archangel of the Host of Herons
Sigarda the Hope of the Lost
description: Sigarda is an archangel of Innistrad who leads the Host of Herons and is the last of her angel sisters.

summary.text: Sigarda is an archangel of Innistrad who leads the Host of Herons and is the last of her angel sisters.

bio.text: Sigarda dwelt in a tower solar in Kessig, where Avacyn, speaking strangely, announced that the great work would begin and departed with Sigarda's sisters Bruna and Gisela.

citations.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

bio.text: She later disowned her fused sisters, was absorbed into the angel-thing, and burst from its chest, killing it.

bio.text: She is recorded as having slain her sisters Bruna and Gisela, and she and her flight survive.
Summoned by Arlinn's faith, she fought Sorin so the others could fetch the key.

timeline.summary: With Avacyn's return, Sigarda and her Host of Herons strive to drive out Stensia's vampires, leaving castles in ruin.
timeline.quote: The angel Sigarda and her Host of Herons strove to drive out the vampires, leaving many castles in ruin.

citation.text: "Stensia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Avacyn's madness and unmaking, Sigarda withdraws to Gavony and the vampires reclaim their fortresses.
timeline.quote: Immune to the angels' madness, Sigarda and her host withdrew to Gavony , and the vampires reclaimed their fortresses

citation.text: "Stensia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Strefan Maurer attacks Heron's Light Hold, killing the knights and forcing Sigarda to flee.
timeline.quote: The hold was attacked by Strefan Maurer , and the knights were all killed, forcing Sigarda to flee.

citation.text: "Stensia", section "Geography of Stensia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anje Falkenrath reclaims the Heron's Grace Monastery built by Sigarda.
timeline.quote: until it was reclaimed by Anje Falkenrath .

citation.text: "Stensia", section "Geography of Stensia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn visits Sigarda with Bruna and Gisela, advocating a genocidal solution and threatening Sigarda.
timeline.quote: Avacyn blew up Sigarda's roof and implied a threat towards her should she not collaborate

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Corruption and death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, fully corrupted, confronts Sigarda and threatens her; Sigarda vows to fight the archangel.
timeline.quote: Sigarda cried and vowed to fight the archangel.

citation.text: "Sigarda", section "Survivor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben Sigarda fights the corrupted angels with Thalia.
timeline.quote: aiding the Cathar Thalia in slaying the monstrosity that was comprised of her former sisters

citation.text: "Sigarda", section "Survivor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sigarda, uneasy at a storm of lightning without thunder, is joined in her solar by her sisters Bruna and Gisela, who are armed and behave strangely.
timeline.quote: Tall Gisela, cloaked in the red and white of her Goldnight flight, her twin blades already out of their sheaths.

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn lands in Sigarda's solar, her speech slurred, her spear twisted and her eyes flashing black.
timeline.quote: As the thunder subsided, Avacyn landed in the solar.

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn announces that the great work is soon to begin.
timeline.quote: The great work is soon to be underway.

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Sigarda recalls how, a thousand years ago, Avacyn destroyed their heretic sister and her entire flight after the sister allied with a demon lord.
timeline.quote: Avacyn single-handedly destroyed their sister and her entire small flight

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn argues that humans are as guilty as the monsters angels fight and must be punished.
timeline.quote: For their crimes we have sought to punish and kill.

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn says Bruna and Gisela have come around to her view, and the two echo her words.
timeline.quote: It took Bruna and Gisela some time to understand as well.

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn obliterates the stone roof of the solar with a surge of power and departs with Bruna and Gisela.
timeline.quote: A surge of power leapt from the spear, and the roof...vanished.

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Sigarda resolves to fight Avacyn, even alone.
timeline.quote: This time I fight.

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben, empowered by Traft's geist, Thalia fights Eldrazi; Sigarda rescues her from Brisela and they defeat the fused sisters.
timeline.quote: Together, Thalia and Sigardia bested the fused sisters.

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sigarda arrives and disowns her fused sisters.
timeline.quote: You are no longer my sisters,

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sigarda slashes her sisters with her scythe but is snatched and being absorbed into the angel-thing.
timeline.quote: But one of those huge, strangely bifurcated arms snatched Sigarda out of the air.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sigarda bursts from the dying angel-thing's chest, and the creature falls dead, calling her sister.
timeline.quote: And it followed Sigarda to the hard stone of the plaza below, curling like a dead spider on the ground.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: A vast tentacled thing approaches Thraben as a tidal wave of corrupted monsters smashes into the plaza.
timeline.quote: As it approached, a tidal wave of corrupted monstrosities crested before it, smashing into the plaza and turning the tide once more toward annihilation.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: The Flights of Goldnight and Alabaster side with Avacyn against humanity, while the Flight of Herons sides with humanity.
timeline.quote: They were the only flight to side with humanity against Avacyn, avoiding corruption.

citation.text: "Angel", section "The Flight of Herons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sigarda resists Emrakul's influence and defends humanity, giving rise to the Sigardian Sect.
timeline.quote: Sigarda and the remnants of her Flight were of the few angels who never succumbed to Emrakul's influence

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "The Sigardian Sect". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Thraben Sigarda slays Brisela, and Jace and Tamiyo imprison Emrakul in the Moon of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren and Tamiyo imprisoned Emrakul within the Moon of Innistrad

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sigarda arrives in golden light and blocks Sorin's blow with her heron-headed scythe.
timeline.quote: A feather falls between them, gold and glowing

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Sigarda tells Arlinn the key is in Sorin's chambers on the third floor and fights Sorin so the others can go.
timeline.quote: You will find the Moonsilver Key in Sorin's personal chambers on the third floor.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin refuses to give up the Key and strikes Arlinn; Sigarda appears and stops the attack, letting the group take the Key.
timeline.quote: Sigarda appeared, answering a prayer made by the group before entering the Manor, and stopped the attack

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin attacks Arlinn when Avacyn is mentioned; Sigarda appears and stops him.
timeline.quote: Again she mentions Avacyn and is attacked again, but this time Sigarda appears and stops the attack.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren disturbs the Dawnhart ritual, begins the Eternal Night, captures Sigarda and plans to marry Edgar Markov to control the bloodlines.
timeline.quote: Olivia sought to take control over the vampiric bloodlines by marrying the charmed Edgar Markov

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Reign of Olivia Voldaren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and the coven's spirit foil Olivia, who flees; the ritual ends the Eternal Night.
timeline.quote: caused the Eternal Night to end and the sun to rise again, ending Olivia's scheme

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Reign of Olivia Voldaren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sigarda appears and stops Sorin's attack so the party can take the Key.
timeline.quote: Sigarda appeared, answering a prayer made by the group before entering the Manor, and stopped the attack

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin refuses to hand over the Key and attacks Arlinn; Sigarda appears and stops him, and the group finds the Key in his quarters.
timeline.quote: In the second attack Sigarda appears

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin's attack on Olivia awakens Katilda's spirit from the Key, which frees the captive Sigarda.
timeline.quote: used her powers to free Sigarda

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sigarda appears and stops Sorin's sword attack, telling Arlinn's group where the Key is while she battles him.
timeline.quote: The second time, Sigarda appears and stops Sorin's sword attack.

citation.text: "Sigarda", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin, brooding in Markov Manor, refuses to give up the Moonsilver Key and attacks Arlinn's group until Sigarda intervenes.
timeline.quote: refused to relinquish the Moonsilver Key simply out of spite

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Battle of Thraben a coalition of vampires, the Order of Saint Traft, the Gatewatch and zombies defeat Emrakul's Eldrazi and Nahiri's cultists after Sigarda kills Brisela; Emrakul is imprisoned in Innistrad's Moon.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was imprisoned within Innistrad's Moon

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia's letter, read to Odric, tells of Avacyn's death, the fall of the archangels and a stronger evil that forced Saint Traft out of her.
timeline.quote: She is dead, too.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The curtains fall to reveal Sigarda bound with red ribbons as a living gift.
timeline.quote: There is no cage save Sigarda's own wings

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin works out that Olivia plans to control angels by drinking Sigarda's blood bound with the Moonsilver Key and Sungold lock.
timeline.quote: Olivia Voldaren with control over all the angels in Innistrad.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A witch's spirit bursts from the Moonsilver Key, grows a staff and asks Olivia whether she would stoop so low.
timeline.quote: this is someone's spirit, separated from their body.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin shoves his grandfather aside and fights Olivia to buy the spirit time, and a verdant bolt frees Sigarda.
timeline.quote: he dashes between her and the key, meeting her head-on charge with a wild slash.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sigarda rises freed, declares all of them guilty and shatters the hall with holy light.
timeline.quote: "All of you are guilty," speaks the angel.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A beam of light shatters Voldaren Manor's windows and the invitation wards crumble, and Arlinn orders the assault.
timeline.quote: she shouts to the others, "Now!"

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn reaches the ballroom, sees Sigarda reaping vampires, and spares a Markov duelist rather than kill him as Tovolar would.
timeline.quote: Arlinn hefts him overhead and hurls him into a column.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin disrupts Olivia's wedding and she drops the Key; Katilda's spirit frees Sigarda, whose holy aura breaks the manor's wards.
timeline.quote: Sorin managed to disrupt the ceremony and attacked Olivia who dropped the Moonsilver Key

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin attacks Olivia during the vows and Sigarda is freed, shattering the glass.
timeline.quote: Katilda used her powers to free Sigarda from her prison.

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda's soul is revealed to be in the Key; her spirit emerges to free Sigarda.
timeline.quote: Katilda manifested coming out of the Key in the form of a spirit, using her powers to free Sigarda.

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia charms Edgar with her blood so he agrees to marry her, planning to control Innistrad's angels with Sigarda's blood.
timeline.quote: Olivia used her blood to wake Edgar from his sleep and, in doing so, managed to charm him.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin attacks during the wedding; Katilda frees Sigarda, whose outburst shatters the glass and wounds guests.
timeline.quote: Katilda used her powers to free Sigarda from her prison.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia captures and imprisons Sigarda after her fight with Sorin.
timeline.quote: After fighting Sorin, she was captured and imprisoned by Olivia Voldaren

citation.text: "Sigarda", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda frees Sigarda, whose angelic burst shatters the wedding hall's windows.
timeline.quote: Upon being released Sigarda exploded her angelic aura in fury

citation.text: "Sigarda", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda frees Sigarda, whose fury shatters the wedding hall.
timeline.quote: Katilda used her powers to free the angel Sigarda from her prison.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sigarda defends Innistrad in the New Phyrexian Invasion and channels Halo.
timeline.quote: Sigarda fought to defend Innistrad during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Sigarda", section "The Invasion's Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
